name: Tōgō (Tottori, Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Tōgō town emblem in white: an outlined ring open at the top enclosing a stylised character with a vertical bar.
history: Flag of the former town of Tōgō in Tottori Prefecture, dissolved on 2004-10-01.

features.role: Tōgō town emblem — an outlined ring open at the top enclosing a stylised character with a vertical bar
